about.description: Hibachi is a perpetual DEX with an off-chain order book and zk-proven settlement on Arbitrum. It offers perpetual futures on crypto, FX and commodities, with FX markets trading 24/5. Positions are margined and cash-settled in USDT, and accounts open with a wallet or an email without KYC.
about.registryInfo: Hibachi PTE. LTD. is the entity named in the terms of service, under Singapore law; no registered address or founders are disclosed. The team cites backgrounds at Citadel, Tower Research, IMC, Meta, Google, Amazon and Hashflow. Hibachi raised a $5M seed in March 2025 from Dragonfly, Electric Capital and Echo.
about.regulatoryStatus: Not registered or licensed by any regulator by its own terms, and unavailable in the US and UK.

fees.revenueNotes: Hibachi base fees: 0 bps maker / 4.5 bps taker. The taker fee falls with 14-day rolling volume and the maker fee is 0 bps at every tier. Funding is paid between longs and shorts with no exchange cut. One schedule covers all perpetual markets. Sources: https://docs.hibachi.xyz/hibachi-docs/trading/fees, https://docs.hibachi.xyz/hibachi-docs/trading/funding
